findings.title: The hero picture does not show the waiting list

location.description: the caption of the plot card in the hero

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees that plots 3 and 8 are empty, but not what Plotwise does about it. The promise that the empty plot goes to the next person in line is left for the reader to imagine.

current.value: The plot card shows empty plots 3 and 8 and the caption "Elm Row Gardens, plots 1 to 12"; nothing shows a next person or an offer

findings.target: The plot card shows what happens to plot 3 or plot 8, and the caption states that point.
findings.fix_direction: Keep the plot card. Make it show what happens to plot 3 or plot 8, and change the caption to state that point. The content (who is next, what the offer looks like) must come from the maker.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the plot card shows what happens to plot 3 or plot 8 after it falls empty, and the caption says so.

findings.title: The rent reminder line does not say whether March is an example or a fixed date

location.description: the text of the Rent reminders card

findings.viewer_experience: A reader cannot tell whether March is an example or a limit.

current.value: "Each grower gets one reminder before rent is due in March."

findings.target: The line says whether March is an example or a fixed date.
findings.fix_direction: Change the line so it says whether March is an example or a fixed date. The fact is missing from the page; the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the Rent reminders line makes clear whether March is an example or a fixed date.

findings.title: Nothing next to the button says what the first step involves

location.description: the "Add your garden" button in the hero

findings.viewer_experience: A reader does not know what the first step involves or what it costs before they click.

current.value: No line next to the button

findings.target: A short line next to the button says what the first step involves.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short line next to the button that says what the first step involves. The fact is missing from the page; the maker must supply it.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, a short line next to "Add your garden" says what the first step involves.

findings.title: The tablet plot card stops short of the right edge of the card grid

location.description: the plot card in the hero on the tablet

findings.viewer_experience: The right edge of the card does not line up with anything, about 120 px short of the right edge of the card grid below.

current.value: 520 px wide, right edge about 120 px short of the card grid edge

findings.target: The plot card is the full content width, or its edge lines up with a column edge.
findings.fix_direction: Make the plot card the full content width or line it up with a column edge.

closed_when.check: In the tablet image, the right edge of the plot card is the same as the right edge of the card grid or of a column.
